reason: I need my phone within reach at night for the kids and emergencies, and a favourites setting in another room does not get me out of bed fast enough. I would end up with this on the nightstand and the phone next to it anyway, so it is just a 120 euro alarm clock.
objection: If something happens with the kids I want my phone on the nightstand, not down the hall. And I doubt a bedside object would stop me scrolling when the phone is still in the house and I can just go and get it.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that an emergency call from family reliably gets through to this device itself or wakes me properly, so the phone really can stay in another room without me worrying.
